ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: logsigmoid_advantage_gap_margin_sqrt
ir.intuition: To fix the novelty failure due to high similarity with existing logsigmoid losses using squared advantage gap, I replaced the squared advantage gap with the square root of the absolute advantage gap to reduce similarity and introduce a distinct nonlinearity. I also added a small clamping on the margin (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) to keep numerical stability and introduce subtle behavioral difference. This preserves the margin-based logsigmoid form highlighting correct ranking, uses advantage gap as a quality signal, keeps pairwise probability mode, and maintains weighting by example weights. These changes reduce similarity by modifying the exponent and input transformation while maintaining a clear preference signal.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_abs = abs(advantage_gap)
adv_sqrt = sqrt(adv_abs)
score_diff = clamp(log_prob_w - log_prob_l, min=-10, max=10)
loss = -logsigmoid(score_diff) * adv_sqrt * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    adv_sqrt = ops.sqrt(adv_abs)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_clamped = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin_clamped))
    loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(loss_raw, adv_sqrt), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
